high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from a news article on The Times of India website. The article discusses ancient astronomical symbols and their interpretations by scientists. The text mentions a specific example found at Burzahoma near Srinagar, where a hunting scene was drawn on a small rock. This drawing shows two equally bright objects resembling the Sun or the Moon, and it is believed to be at least 4,500 years old. Scientists suggest that this drawing might depict a supernova that lit up the ancient sky. Below the text, there is an image of a rock with ancient drawings etched into it.
